text:
katie: Heads-up: Acme reporting intermittent 502s and timeouts on hosted /v1/generate (us-west) since ~09:00 PDT. P95 generation latency jumped to ~6s then 502s. They see SDK retry loops and increased token billing.

emily: Do we have a repro request from them? any pattern (long prompts, streaming vs non-streaming, embeddings)?

katie: They say it happens on large prompts (~8k tokens) and streaming. SDK is @redwood-js v0.9.3 with default retrying. They attached a curl and a small JS snippet.

emily: paste curl + headers so we can try locally. also ask for region and request id if available.

katie: curl they sent:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-ACME" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"<very long prompt...>","stream":true}'
```

katie: They included x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d and saw first attempt 2024-09-07T16:58:10Z 502, then SDK retried 3 times and finally got 504 on the client.

raj: I pulled the gateway logs for rq_0a1b2c3d — ingress hit an overloaded edge cluster (usw2-edge-4) and backend pool returned NO_RESPONSE for the stream session. Looks like TCP keepalive closed mid-kv-cache warmup.

leo: Could be the long prefix + streaming causing memory/kv lock stall on that serving host. Any matching host-level OOMs?

raj: No OOMs. I see repeated connection resets (RST) from the proxy to the runtime around the same minute. Also note token auth refresh spike at 16:58:09Z from that tenant (multiple concurrent inbound token verifications).

emily: two immediate things for customer and for triage: 1) temporary mitigation — route them to a different region (us-east) or use non-streaming until we patch; 2) repro steps for us.

katie: Customer prefers mitigation that avoids code change. I proposed a per-tenant region pin to us-east for now. They agreed to a short switch.

leo: For repro, can someone run the exact curl with the long prompt and stream=false and then stream=true against both us-west and us-east to compare? Also capture tcpdump on the edge host if we can reproduce.

raj: I'll spin a diagnostics run. Quick repro steps I used locally:

```
# non-streaming
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"REPEAT(\"x\",8000)","stream":false}' \
  https://us-west.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -D >(grep -i x-request-id)

# streaming
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"REPEAT(\"x\",8000)","stream":true}' \
  https://us-west.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

raj: On my run I reproduced a 502 on stream=true within 10s and saw proxy RST to backend. On us-east same test succeeded (streaming fine, p95 ~1.2s).

emily: That matches: edge cluster capacity/keepalive behavior in us-west. We should also look at SDK retry policy — the default backoff + multiple sync retries are likely amplifying load and billing.

leo: Can we set a short-term rule: if tenant X sees >20% stream errors in 5m, automatically reduce client retries to 1 and route to fallback region? We have the routing hooks to do that per-tenant.

katie: I'll get consent from Acme to enable routing fallback + retry cap for the next 6 hours. They want status updates every 30min.

raj: Action items for eng infra:
- [raj] collect full tcpdump & proxy logs for the minute window (done, uploading)
- [leo] check serving node kv-cache warmup locks for rw-large-1 (oncall)
- [emily] follow up with customer with mitigation and ask for SDK logs (x-request-ids) and sample prompt

leo: Quick hypothesis: long prefix makes runtime do expensive kv cache population at first tokens; if proxy drops connection during that window, runtime leaves session half-closed and proxy triggers retries. We need a graceful early 429 or hint to client to slow-start.

emily: For customer comms: I drafted a short note — TL;DR: "We're seeing intermittent 502s from us-west for large streaming requests. We've routed your traffic to us-east and capped SDK retries to prevent duplicate billing while we investigate. We'll update in 30 mins." Want me to post?

katie: Post away and include temporary workaround steps + ask them to confirm no config changes on their side.

infra-bot: Diagnostic bundle uploaded: /artifacts/rq_0a1b2c3d/1728501234.tar.gz (size 18MB)

raj: Next technical steps: compare kernel TCP keepalive settings across edge clusters, add probe to detect long-prefix streaming heat, and consider a small runtime change to early-ack prompt receipt before kv warmup to avoid proxy timeouts.

katie: I'll schedule a follow-up sync in 45m if we need deep-dive. For now Acme routing to us-east is live and they reported initial success (one generation succeeded).

emily: Good. Also filing a billing note to avoid charging for obvious retry storm from their tenant during the incident window.

leo: I'll start a small perf test fleet against us-west with a longer keepalive and incremental kv preload to see if that improves.

katie: Thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and close the loop after the 30m check-in.
